why: the r17 mechanism chain has two separate interventions: the tool-round guard (a HOST-SIDE controller configuration) and the compression plugin (the mechanism under test)
leaving the guard on one arm only would add a controller to that arm and not to the others; r17 therefore installs it on every arm and asserts it stays inert on the non-plugin arms
a pass must consequently be reported as the effect of compression UNDER THAT HOST CONFIGURATION, never as compression alone
control_configuration_sentence: 本次测量是在**装上工具轮守卫的主机配置**下进行的：守卫是宿主侧控制器配置（四个臂全部安装，见 manifest 的 guard_scope / guard_installed_arms），不是插件机制的一部分。
allowed_pass_wording: 在装上工具轮守卫的主机配置下，插件在等质量前提下省 X%（配对数 n/n，同工作量 m/m）。
forbidden_pass_wording: 压缩机制带来 X% 收益（未限定主机配置）
本批证明该宿主首个有效节省（未限定形状与盲性）
boundary_sentences: 压缩收益是在该主机配置下测得的：守卫在合规臂上是空操作（逐单元断言零拒绝），因此本批的对照是「同一配置下有无压缩」。
若守卫在基线臂触发，本批立即停止：那说明该主机配置下的工具表约束不是单向的，本批不得当作插件效果证据。
这四个任务是在设计守卫时构造的 ⇒ 结论只能是「该形状上守卫使第一角色走完冻结工具表」的开发证据；确认须在守卫冻结后另建全新任务。
上界是解析界（压缩侧受界/估计），不是实测：只有三臂小试给出实测配对值。

stop_condition.trigger: any guard rejection or exhaustion recorded on a non-plugin arm
stop_condition.action: stop the batch immediately, keep the partial directory, report it, and do not use the batch as plugin-effect evidence
stop_condition.audit_support: audit_crewai_handoff_v16 checks guard_installed_arms and raises 'guard fired on a non-plugin arm (r17 stop condition)'

pre_payment_evidence.finding: on the recorded r16 sequences the v17 guard would have refused nothing on any of the 24 non-plugin units, and would have refused 7 plugin units
pre_payment_evidence.note: this is why installing the guard on every arm is a no-op on the compliant arms' behaviour; the next batch must still assert it per unit
